pages.text: Carbon dioxide absorbs the infrared the ground gives off: more of it, more heat kept, by a radiative forcing ΔF = 5.35 ln(C/C₀) W/m² (C₀ = 280 ppm). Aerosols reflect sunlight back out, about −20 W/m² per unit of optical depth. The world's temperature follows, ΔT = λΔF, with a climate sensitivity λ near 0.8 K per W/m².
$(thing)Set$(): Carbon dioxide, Aerosol optical depth.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Feedbacks: the sensitivity varies by ±10%·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): Runaway warming: the engine's own feedbacks are tearing it apart.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): Small changes settle faster.
